models.name: shufflecugan_x2
models.license: arch MIT (bilibili); weights personal use (TAS mirror)
models.notes: ShuffleCUGAN x2 (UpCunet2x_fast: internal PixelUnshuffle 3ch->12ch). Tiny (1.4M params), fast, anime-tuned. Input dims must be multiples of 4 and >= 40; the stage pads automatically. Same file TAS's registry points at.

models.name: realesrgan_x4plus
models.recommended_for: live action / general (Live Action preset default)
models.notes: Battle-tested x4 SR + denoise. Weights are NC-licensed: OK for personal use per project decision D3.

models.name: fallin_soft
models.license: arch MIT (bilibili Real-CUGAN family); weights personal use (TAS mirror)
models.notes: Fallin soft: same UpCunet2x_fast arch as ShuffleCUGAN (1.4M params), different weights; input dims must be multiples of 4 and >= 40, the stage pads automatically. Same file TAS's registry points at.

models.name: fallin_strong
models.license: arch MIT (bilibili Real-CUGAN family); weights personal use (TAS mirror)
models.notes: Fallin strong: same UpCunet2x_fast arch as ShuffleCUGAN (1.4M params), different weights; input dims must be multiples of 4 and >= 40, the stage pads automatically. Same file TAS's registry points at.

models.name: span_v2
models.license: arch Apache-2.0 (umzi2/traiNNer-redux; Conv3XC from TArdelean/DynamicConvolution MIT); weights personal use (TAS mirror)
models.recommended_for: anime x2 - SPAN family, higher quality than CUGAN-class models
models.notes: SPAN arch (2.2M params): 20 reparameterizable Conv3XC blocks + sigmoid-gated SPAB attention; trained with norm=False (no input normalization). Kernel fusion runs once after load. No size constraints.

models.name: cyte_v1
models.license: arch Apache-2.0 (BasicSR family); weights CC BY-NC 4.0 (NevermindNilas/Ai-models) - NON-COMMERCIAL only ⚠️
models.recommended_for: anime x2 - ultra-light compact model, fastest of the lineup
models.notes: Cyte V1 SuperUltraCompact (0.05M params): umzi2 compact SRVGG (Conv+PReLU stack + PixelShuffle + nearest-neighbor residual). Weights are CC BY-NC 4.0: OK for personal use per project decision D3, must stay marked NC in the UI model list. Hosted on NevermindNilas/Ai-models (raw.githubusercontent), not TAS-Models-Host - same special-case host TAS's own downloader uses.

models.name: openproteus
models.license: arch Apache-2.0 (umzi2/traiNNer-redux); weights personal use (TAS mirror)
models.recommended_for: anime x2 - compact model with a good speed/quality balance
models.notes: OpenProteus Compact i2 70K (0.6M params): umzi2 compact SRVGG (Conv+PReLU stack + PixelShuffle + nearest-neighbor residual). No size constraints.

models.name: rife_425
models.notes: Practical-RIFE 4.25 flownet.pkl - upstream's recommended default for most scenes. The Drive link serves a zipped folder bundle; extract_member picks the checkpoint out of it.

models.name: rife_425_heavy
models.recommended_for: highest-quality interpolation; ~2x the compute of default RIFE 4.25
models.notes: Channel-doubled IFNet variant of RIFE 4.25. No official 'heavy' release exists upstream, so this uses the TAS community mirror (same file TAS's own registry points at).

models.name: rife_425_lite
models.recommended_for: fast interpolation; slightly lower quality than default RIFE 4.25
models.notes: Narrow final-block variant of RIFE 4.25 (block4 c=24). An official 4.25.lite exists on Practical-RIFE's Drive, but the TAS mirror is a single-file download.

models.name: m2m
models.license: Adobe Research License (non-commercial research only; no redistribution) ⚠️
models.recommended_for: experimental: efficient at high multipliers (4x-8x) - motion estimated once per pair
models.notes: M2M_VFI (feinanshan). PyTorch reference implementation targets old torch/CUDA; adapter not yet implemented. Weights are a single Drive file.

models.name: gmfss
models.license: No license file upstream ⚠️ (personal use only)
models.recommended_for: experimental: anime-oriented interpolation; TAS's best-maintained community variant
models.notes: GMFSS (routineLife1/GMFSS) weights bundle as mirrored by TAS. Upstream project is archived in favor of GMFSS_Fortuna (98mxr). Requires the CUDA softsplat kernel (TAS vendors it under src/gmfss/); adapter not yet implemented.

models.name: film
models.notes: FILM (google-research/frame-interpolation). Official weights are TF2 SavedModels in a Google Drive folder (id 1q8110-qp225asX3DQvZnfLfJPkCHmDpy); no single-file URL, so download stays disabled until the adapter picks specific files. Adapter not yet implemented.

models.name: amt_sicdia
models.recommended_for: experimental: SOTA large-motion interpolation; also the planned ghost-repair alternate model (M4)
models.notes: AMT-SICDIA (Adaptive Motion Transformer). Public weights URL not located as of 2026-09-17; confirm at adapter time. Adapter not yet implemented.
